Ins"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"tall the bundle, run one setup script, restart the Harness, and the agent gains persistent-memory to"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ols named `mcp__memos__*`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"With the bundle active, the agent can call (a subset of the MemOS MCP surface):"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Tool | Purpose |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `add_memory` | add a memory from text, a document, or conversation messages |
| `search_memories` "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"| semantic search across the user's memory cubes |
| `get_memory` / `update_memory` / `delete_memory"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"` | inspect / correct / remove single memories |
| `create_cube` / `register_cube` / `share_cube` | "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"manage memory cubes |
| `chat` | memory-enhanced chat with the MOS system |
| `control_memory_schedu"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ler` | start/stop the async memory scheduler |
| … | 16 tools total, listed by the smoke test |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The bundle contributes only a configuration layer (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`); it mounts the"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` plugin with a `stdio` server row. No Harness code is modified."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- `dsh` CLI installed (the bundle relies on its built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`).
- A MemOS c"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"heckout with its docker stack up (the compose in `MemOS/docker` provides Neo4j + Qdrant + the MemOS "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"API).
- Python ≥ 3.10 for the MemOS virtualenv.
- The MemOS LLM and embedding gateway reachable from"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" the machine that runs the MCP child (see Endpoint resolution)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install the bundle"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Pick **one** of the three paths — they install the same files."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### A. From npm (recommended)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"No `git` binary, no GitHub access, no build step. If the registry answers `404`, the package has not"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" been published yet — use path B or C."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### B. From git"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"This runs `git ls-remote` under pnpm, so it needs **git on `PATH`** *and* a reachable github.com. Be"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"hind a restricted network this is the step that fails first:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Check with `git --version`. If git is missing, install it; if github.com is unreachable, use path C."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### C. Use an 8.3 short path (`C:\Users\GUL"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ING~1\...`) or `add .` from a space-free directory."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**0. Start the MemOS infrastructure first** — the MCP server requires Neo4j at startup and search/ch"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"at need the LLM + embedding gateway:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"If the stack is down when `dsh` starts, the runner prints one clear line and exits; the client's rec"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"onnect policy keeps retrying, so starting the stack later recovers automatically — no GUI restart."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**1. Set up the MemOS side** (venv + dependencies + source patches + local tokenizer):"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"On POSIX: `./setup.sh --memos /path/to/MemOS`. This creates `MemOS/.venv`, installs `MemoryOS[tree-m"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"em]` plus `python-dotenv`, `tqdm`, `langchain_text_splitters`, `chonkie`, applies the required sourc"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"e patches (see below), and downloads a local gpt2 tokenizer.json (HuggingFace mirror first)."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"**2. Install the bundle** — see Install the bundle."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**3. Configure paths** (the patch reads these at boot; both optional):"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"When `MEMOS_PYTHON` is unset the row falls back to `python` on `PATH`; when `MEMOS_HOME` is unset th"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"e child runs in the Harness process cwd (MemOS still reads its `.env`, so point `MEMOS_HOME` at the "},{"id":"p40s3","text":"checkout unless MemOS is the launch directory)."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**4. Verify and restart:**"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"The bundle's patch inserts two rows: the `memos-bridge` provider (exposes `memosBridge` with the ven"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"v python, this package's runner path, the child cwd, and the tool namespace) and the `memos-mcp` `@d"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"eepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row that spawns the runner over stdio. The runner **preflights** Neo4j (h"},{"id":"p44s4","text":"ard dependency: clear one-line error + fast exit), warns when the LLM/embedding gateway is down, and"},{"id":"p44s5","text":" resolves host-run endpoints."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"Environment knobs read at mount time:"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"| Variable | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"| `MEMOS_PYTHON` | `python` | python of the MemOS venv |
| `MEMOS_HOME` | Harness cwd | MemOS checko"},{"id":"p47s2","text":"ut used as the child cwd |
| `MEMOS_MCP_SERVER` | `memos` | tool namespace (`mcp__<name>__*`), `[A-Z"},{"id":"p47s3","text":"ld cwd |
| `MEMOS_MCP_SERVER` | `memos` | tool namespace (`mcp__<name>__*`), `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}` |"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"`cwd` is never empty: the provider resolves `MEMOS_HOME` and falls back to the Harness process cwd, "},{"id":"p48s2","text":"because an empty cwd makes the MCP SDK spawn fail with a bare `ENOENT` that looks like a missing int"},{"id":"p48s3","text":"n empty cwd makes the MCP SDK spawn fail with a bare `ENOENT` that looks like a missing interpreter."},{"id":"p49s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"## Endpoint resolution"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"MemOS's `.env` commonly targets `host.docker.internal:18181/18182` (valid *inside* the MemOS docker "},{"id":"p51s2","text":"network). When the MCP child runs on the **host**, the runner resolves endpoints in this order:"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"| Priority | Source | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p53s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"The MCP server command runs as **trusted executable code outside the agent sandbox** (this is why th"},{"id":"p55s2","text":"e Harness enables no MCP server by default). Only connect to MemOS servers you run yourself."},{"id":"p56s1","text":"Two consequences worth knowing:"},{"id":"p57s1","text":"- `patch_memos.py` edits a third-party checkout in place. Read `--list` before running it; `--revert"},{"id":"p57s2","text":"` restores the backups.
- The Harness forwards a scrubbed environment to MCP children: names matchin"},{"id":"p57s3","text":"g `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `SECRET`, `PASSWORD`, and every `DSH_*` variable are dropped. Secrets belong in Me"},{"id":"p57s4","text":"mOS's own `.env` or in an explicit row `env` block."}],"truncated":true}
